revision_note: v2.2 (2026-10-12): shutdown wording - the v1 pintle closing speed "<= 50 mm/s (80 ms full stroke)" is retired (no combustion basis; lead request on the HV69 drive); start ramp marked as a cap; floor-start t90 added to model_transients. Torch sizing unchanged (recomputed, same inputs).
decision: spark-ignited N2O/propane torch (baseline kept); arc-ABS kept as a research option for bench tests (would remove the propane system)

trade.scale: 1 (poor) .. 5 (good); scores are engineering judgement (DERIVED), stated with their reason

arc_ABS.desc: HV arc across electrodes embedded in the printed ABS at the head end pyrolyses fuel; N2O flow then ignites (USU / Whitmore type)
arc_ABS.reasons: no extra fluid, many relights shown with GOX; with N2O the published work (as recalled, LITERATURE-UNVERIFIED here) needed higher arc power or an O2 assist; electrodes must be printed into every grain; 200-1000 V class supply near the avionics; restart surface is charred

torch_N2O_propane.desc: spark-ignited N2O/propane torch firing radially into the pre-chamber (v1 baseline)
torch_N2O_propane.reasons: independent of grain state; ~3 kW hot jet for 0.3-0.6 s per start; restarts limited only by propane (0.05 g/start); needs a propane cylinder, 2 NC solenoids, 2 check valves and a spark plug; widely used on amateur and university hybrids; orifice sizes are small (0.15-0.3 mm)

pyrotechnic.desc: electric match + pyrogen pellet per start (one cartridge per start, 3+ ports or a revolver)
pyrotechnic.reasons: excellent first start; each restart needs its own cartridge, port and seal; debris into the injector region; explosives handling and storage rules in Denmark (TO-VERIFY with the authorities and ACEMA rules)

catalytic_N2O.desc: pre-heated N2O decomposition catalyst (Rh/Ir class on alumina) feeding hot O2/N2 to the grain
catalytic_N2O.reasons: needs 50-200 W preheat for minutes and a catalyst bed (cost TO-QUOTE); bed poisoning and decomposition propagating upstream into the feed is the N2O hazard this design must avoid

sizing.note: Cd 0.65 (N2O sharp orifice) and 0.80 (propane) ASSUMED; torch Pc 3 bar abs keeps the torch outlet choked into the cold chamber (~1 bar) and stays below the propane vapour pressure down to ~0 C (4.7 bar); calibrate both orifices by cold flow (weighing) before hot torch tests

envelope.mount: radial boss on the head section at x_face 0.015 m, axis inclined 30 deg inward/aft so the plug end stays inside the 120 mm head sweep (answers Mechanical REQUEST 2026-10-12)

torch.materials: 316L body, PTFE/FKM seals, nickel-electrode micro spark plug (model-engine class, TO-QUOTE)

mass_estimate_kg.tag: ASSUMED: body 50 g, plug 10 g, two micro solenoids 60-120 g, propane cylinder 50 g, lines/fittings 50 g

arm_preconditions: tank 15-25 C (heater blanket for cold days; supercharge not baselined)
pintle seated, position encoder healthy, isolation valve closed
igniter continuity checked (spark coil primary, both solenoids)
Pc, P_feed, P_tank sensors healthy; Pc reads ambient +/- 0.1 bar

start.action: ONLY if the line is not primed (P_feed < 0.5 P_tank, e.g. first start after a purge): pintle to a 0.10 mm bleed lift BEFORE the isolation valve moves, so the line vents through the injector (no dead-ended adiabatic compression of trapped gas: N2 isentropic 847-913 K, N2O vapour 614-646 K at 45-60 bar, feed_line_checks_v2.json); isolation valve opening ramp >= 0.3 s

primed line (relight, P_feed >= 0.5 P_tank): open the NC isolation valve with the pintle seated; unprimed line: isolation valve fully open by now and the pintle returns to seated; vapour-first (warm line flashes)
open torch solenoids (N2O SOL1, propane SOL2)
spark train 50 Hz, 50 mJ, up to 0.5 s
torch-flame confirmation (photodiode or 0.25 mm thermocouple at the torch outlet, Electronics to select; fallback = timing only)
pintle to the ignition lift (12.5-20 % flow, ~0.2-0.3 mm at 20 C)
ignition check: Pc > 3.0 bar abs (combustion 4.4-6.2 bar vs cold N2O flow ~1.5 bar); if not, ABORT
ramp to the commanded thrust at <= 2500 N/s (gnc.json engine model slew; a cap: the drive must give >= 2 F_max/s, gnc.json v2 ENG-03)
propane solenoid closed before Pc exceeds 5 bar (propane vapour pressure 6.4 bar at 10 C)
N2O torch solenoid closed; spark off

abort_if_no_ignition: wait >= 5 s for the chamber to vent N2O (no re-try into a pooled chamber)
one automatic retry allowed in flight only if GNC margin permits; ground: safe the stand and investigate
shutdown: pintle closes to the seat at the drive's full speed (v2.2: the v1 "<= 50 mm/s (80 ms full stroke)" is retired; no combustion limit on the closing time; the ENG-05 tail-off sets the closing speed: combustion.json valves_and_actuators.pintle_actuator.speed_checks)
isolation valve closes after the pintle is seated (<= 0.15 s)
trapped liquid between the isolation valve and the pintle is relieved to the tank side (v1 requirement)
post-burn: chamber vents through the nozzle; the grain smoulders briefly in air
relight: same as start from t = 0 (the isolation valve may stay open between burns in flight)
settling: liquid at the tank outlet must be confirmed by the acceleration history (A1 has 15 s at ~1 g before relight; settling_v2.json)
torch fires into a hot, fuel-rich chamber: lower ignition energy expected
flashback_and_backflow: check valve on each torch line at the torch inlet (cracking <= 0.3 bar), rated to chamber MEOP 45 bar and hot gas
torch lines dead-ended during the main burn: the torch body sees Pc and soak heat; it is sized for MEOP 45 bar and checked for 30 s exposure (Mechanical)
no N2O purge through the torch during the main burn (a hot N2O-filled cavity is a decomposition site)

N2O decomposition in the feed: no heat source upstream of the injector, no adiabatic compression of vapour pockets (valves open slowly when lines contain vapour), clean Krytox-lubricated hardware only
purge: ground tests: N2 purge of the chamber after shutdown (stand-side valve, 5-10 s) and before a re-start attempt
flight: no purge gas carried (no N2 system baselined); the chamber vents through the nozzle

model_transients: SIM grain_q1d v2 (ASSUMED torch-to-main delay 0.10 s, 30 % preheated regression at main-flow arrival): relights in A1/A2 reach 10 % thrust 0.10-0.11 s and 90 % 0.28-0.29 s after the command; DC-D first start t10-90 0.04 s. Ignition delay is the least certain input: static fire measures it. Step starts to the 12.5 % / 20 % floor reach 90 % at 0.52-0.53 s / 0.43-0.44 s for every drive speed 0.08-0.40 s full stroke (actuator_rate_check_v2.json).
